title: Austria: Austrian-based authorised representative for foreign sellers
summary: Since 1 January 2023 a company without an Austrian establishment, including online retailers selling into Austria, must appoint an Austrian-based authorised representative to hold its packaging obligations. There is no distance-selling carve-out from the underlying registration and system-participation duties.

required_evidence.label: Signed appointment of the authorised representative

sources.title: § 16a-16d Verpackungsverordnung (ARA — Bevollmächtigter Vertreter)
sources.note: Fetched the regulation text directly. FINDING that revises this row's own summary, same shape as the PPWR AR row held at PR #4 (D-040): the statute draws a mandatory/optional line by customer type, which 'no distance-selling carve-out' gets backwards. § 12b(1) AWG 2002 makes appointment MANDATORY ('haben ... zu bestellen') only for the Primaerverpflichtete defined at § 13g(1)(5) -- 'Versandhaendler, die keinen Sitz und keine Niederlassung in Oesterreich haben und die Verpackungen ... in Oesterreich an einen PRIVATEN Letztverbraucher im Rahmen des Fernabsatzes uebergeben' (distance sellers with no AT seat selling to PRIVATE end consumers). Separately, § 16a VerpackVO gives EU-established sellers who sell to NON-private (business) end users only an OPTIONAL right to appoint one ('koennen') -- not a duty. Confirmed the effective date precisely: § 16a(5), appointment can be made from 1 Oct. 2022 but 'entfaltet ... erst mit 1. Jaenner 2023 Rechtswirkung' (has legal effect only from 1 Jan 2023) -- matches effective_from exactly. RECOMMENDATION, not applied this pass: add organisation.sells_direct_to_end_users: true to applies_when, reusing the exact fact introduced for eu.ppwr.authorised-representative (D-040) -- same underlying distinction, same fix shape, pending Tabeen's sign-off rather than applied unilaterally here.
